dedupe_keys.name: jeplus and jeplus ea parametric and optimisation tools for energyplus and trnsys

description: jEPlus is a parametric tool for EnergyPlus and TRNSYS that sets up and runs large batches of simulations from parameter definitions, and jEPlus+EA adds optimisation, parametric projects and sensitivity analyses on the JEA engine. The site's news records version 2.0 in 2019 on SourceForge, version 2.1 in October 2020 with tutorials, and version 2.2 on 30 September 2024, which added ESO and MTR result objects in the RVX file and support for EnergyPlus basement and slab models; related ENSIMS online tools include an EPW resources map and an IDD browser. Coverage: generic, any EnergyPlus or TRNSYS model. Access: free downloads linked from the wiki. Licence: wiki content CC BY-NC 4.0; the software terms were not read. Caveats: parts of the site were marked as pending updates during an overhaul, and manuals were still in development at the 2.1 release. Simulation uses: design space exploration, sensitivity and multi-objective optimisation of building energy models. Related records: EnergyPlus, GenOpt and TRNSYS.
